_comment: TypeSafe Jev relevance tagging for The Grand Illusion Radar. See lib/jev.mjs, tools/jev-export.mjs, and shadow/illusion_relevance/summary.json for the calibration run. Thresholds below are live (rank mode, on unless JEV_RANK=0); they only hide listings behind a UI toggle, never delete them.

illusion_relevance._where: lib/jev.mjs, called from lib/engine.mjs: rank mode tags kept listings (on unless JEV_RANK=0); JEV_SHADOW=1 also logs every graded listing. State is the classify()-graded listing's own public fields; the current rule/lexicon verdict is logged alongside as baseline, never sent to Jev.

state_shape.title: listing title, as scraped
state_shape.description: listing description or subtitle, trimmed to ~500 chars (empty string when the source never captured one, which is every source today)
state_shape.price: priceText or price formatted as text, e.g. '$3,200' or 'no price listed'

stage_illusion.instructions: Based on `title`, `description`, `price` and `source`, is this a full-size stage illusion — a crated, performer-sized magic apparatus like a sawing cabinet, substitution trunk, or levitation frame — rather than a close-up trick, card gimmick, book, poster, or optical-illusion art object?

true.what: a large, performer-scale illusion prop: a cabinet, trunk, box, table, or frame built for a stage act
examples: Zig Zag Girl Illusion - professional stage illusion, local pickup only, on casters
Owen Magic Supreme Sub Trunk Substitution Trunk illusion, crated, freight
John Gaughan Asrah Levitation - ex Doug Henning show
Thin Model Sawing In Half Illusion, stage size, fits a person, $2900 obo

false.what: close-up magic, card gimmicks, books/plans, DVDs, posters, jewelry, novelty items, or anything using 'illusion' as a brand or decorative word rather than describing a stage prop
examples: ZIG ZAG PLAYING CARD SUPER GREAT ILLUSION
JUMBO ZIG ZAG CARD MAGIC TRICK - Stage Prop Poker Size Illusion Gimmick
Building Plans for Robert Harbin's Zig Zag Illusion!
Optical Illusion Wall Art Poster Print 24x36
Illusion Lace Wedding Dress Neckline Bridal Gown
Magic Trick Melon from Box Prop Stage Illusion Gimmick Party Goods E342
DP Group Dice Box Magic Trick Gimmick Prop Stage Illusion Rare Party Goods E471

kind.instructions: What kind of thing is this listing describing, based on `title`, `description`, `price` and `source`?

criteria.illusion_prop: a full-size stage illusion apparatus (crated, performer-sized)
criteria.close_up_or_gimmick: a close-up trick, card gimmick, or small novelty prop
criteria.book_or_plans: building plans, a book, a manual, or instructions
criteria.media: a DVD, download, or other recorded media
criteria.decorative_or_unrelated: art, jewelry, clothing, furniture, electronics, or anything using 'illusion'/'magic' as a brand name rather than describing a magic prop
criteria.other: none of the above, or not enough information to tell

for_sale.instructions: Is this a purchasable listing — an item actually offered for sale, auction, or best offer — rather than a forum thread, discussion post, wanted ad, or review with no item being sold?

criteria.true: a marketplace or auction listing with a price or bid, or a classified offering an item
criteria.false: a forum post, a 'looking for' / wanted ad, a discussion thread, or anything without an actual item on offer

thresholds._basis: 2026-10-08, from shadow/illusion_relevance (495 shadowed listings, 55 hand labels). Half-minimum rule (migration-protocol step 4): the lowest P(yes) Jev gave a labelled true stage illusion was 0.29, so 'not-stage' is below 0.145. On the shadow set that hides 179 of 495 listings, 15 of the 27 labelled junk and none of the 28 labelled trues. 0.145 to 0.5 is 'review' (shown, flagged): all four labelled trues Jev called false sit there, terse Magic Auction-style titles (0.29 to 0.48). Re-check against new labels before moving either cutoff.

before.basis: current path is free (rule/lexicon classify(), no LLM call); this site is additive shadow-mode cost only, not a replacement of a billed call

alert_quality._where: tools/alert.py, the last gate before a SCREAMING DEAL email. Only listings that already passed every code gate (price <= max, firm price, verdict grail/confirmed, Jev band 'stage', deal score, not an excluded family) reach it, so volume is a handful a week. State is the listing's title plus a factual photo description written by one Haiku vision call (Jev is text-only); the description carries no verdict words, Jev makes the call, code sends the mail.

state_shape.title: listing title, as scraped
state_shape.photo_description: 4-6 factual sentences from a vision model about the listing photo: materials, finish, apparent builder grade, condition, and whether it is a real photo of the item

professional_grade.instructions: Based on `photo_description` and `title`, is this a well-built, professional-quality stage illusion in presentable condition, the kind a working illusionist would put on a stage today, rather than something janky?

true.what: solid professional construction (hardwood, aluminium, quality laminate or paint, clean edges, proper hardware), decoration that looks deliberate, intact and usable, at most normal road wear
examples: A tall cabinet in glossy black and gold lacquer with clean edges and chrome hardware, on a matching base with casters, photographed upright in a warehouse; no visible damage.
An aluminium-framed box with professionally printed panels, a road case beside it, light scuffs on the case only.

false.what: homemade or hobby-grade (bare plywood, visible screws and glue, hand-painted lettering, cardboard, PVC), toy or party-store grade, broken, water-damaged, missing parts, peeling or heavily worn, or the photo is too dark, cropped or blurry to judge
examples: A plywood box with uneven hand-brushed paint, exposed screw heads and a piece of tape over one door hinge.
A small plastic toy version of the illusion in retail packaging.
The cabinet has a cracked panel and the finish is peeling along the bottom edge.
A dim, blurry photo of a box in a garage; only one corner is visible.

real_photo.instructions: Based on `photo_description`, is the photo an actual photograph of the specific item being sold, rather than a stock image, catalog render, drawing, or a photo of a performer on stage?

criteria.true: a photograph of the physical item itself, as it sits now (in a room, garage, warehouse, on a stage without an audience)
criteria.false: a stock or catalog image, 3D render, drawing, poster, logo, a show photo with a performer mid-trick, or no usable photo

thresholds._basis: 2026-10-22, ESTIMATED and uncalibrated: only ~15 priced deals exist, far short of the 300-input shadow. Conservative prior: hold anything Jev is not fairly sure is professional. Every gate result is logged to data/alerts.json with its probabilities; re-tune once there are 30+ judged candidates.
